label: Sign In
steps: In Email or Username, enter your registered email or username.
In Password, enter your account password.
On success you are redirected to the dashboard. If you don't have an account yet, click Create one.

label: Create Account
steps: From the login page, click Create one — or open /register directly.
Enter a Password (at least 8 characters) and confirm it in Confirm Password.
Click Create account. On success you are signed in and redirected to the dashboard.

label: Todo Dashboard
steps: When the dashboard opens with no todos, you see an empty state inviting you to create one. Click Create Todo or the floating + button in the bottom right.

Fill the Create New Todo modal: enter a Title (required), an optional Description, choose a Priority (Low, Medium, or High), and optionally pick a Due Date. Click Create Todo to save, or Cancel to dismiss.
Once saved, the todo appears in the list with priority and status badges. Use the round checkbox at the left of a todo to toggle it between Pending and Done.
Use the filter bar above the list to narrow results by Status or Priority, and to sort by Due Date or Created At.
To remove a todo, click the trash icon on its row. A confirmation dialog asks you to confirm; click Delete to remove it permanently or Cancel to keep it.
Use the moon / sun icon in the header to switch between light and dark mode. Your preference is remembered across sessions.
Click Logout in the header to sign out and return to the login page.
